blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型在机器人操控上取得了实质性进展,但其通俗化仍受行动标志机器人演示的多样性和覆盖面所制约. 人类视频提供了更广泛的行为和环境经验,而从中学习则面临可扩展数据和明确行动地面之间的根本取舍。 我们提出思维世界(ThinkWorld),这是一个VLA学习框架,它为世界动态中的行动推理提供依据,并通过用世界想象力强化学习来加强它. ThinkWorld代表每个动作思维作为"动能链"(CoD),是一系列离散运动符号,能捕捉连接当今世界与未来状态的中间动态,并充当跨表现体的共同动作代表. 我们首先以行动标注的演示初始化CoD,然后预测每个CoD所引出的未来,并强化那些预测更能与所观察到的结果相匹配的人. 这使得没有动作说明的视频能够提供从被观测到的状态过渡的直接监督,使人类和机器人的经验能够完善相同的推理空间. 模拟实验和在真机器人上进行的实验,展示了有效的人对机器人的转移和对看不见的任务和环境的强烈概括.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Building general-purpose action models that transfer across tasks, objects, environments, and embodiments is a central goal of robot learning. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; O’Neill et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024a ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ) have made substantial progress by transferring pretrained vision-language knowledge and scaling across heterogeneous robot demonstrations. Nevertheless, their policy learning and behavioral coverage remain largely tied to action-labeled robot trajectories, whose collection requires physical platforms, embodiment-specific interfaces, and substantial human effort. Human videos offer a complementary source of experience with far greater behavioral and environmental diversity, but do not provide directly executable robot actions.
blocks.zh: 建立跨越任务,对象,环境,以及表现的通用行动模式,是机器人学习的中心目标. 近期的视觉语言行动模型(VLAs)(Brohan等人,2023年;O ' Neill等人,2024年;Team等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年;Black等人,2024年a年;Intelligence等人,2025年;Bjorck等人,2025年)通过转移经过预先培训的视觉语言知识和跨越各种机器人演示,取得了实质性的进展。 尽管如此,他们的政策学习和行为覆盖仍然在很大程度上与行动标志机器人轨迹有关,其收集需要物理平台、具体化的界面和大量的人力。 人类的视频提供了一个补充性的经验来源,在行为和环境多样性方面要大得多,但并不能直接提供可执行的机器人动作.

blocks.en: Existing approaches seek to extract actionable supervision from human videos along two main directions. Latent action models ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ) infer transition variables from pairs or sequences of frames and use them for representation or policy learning. While naturally scalable to action-unlabeled videos, these inferred variables are underconstrained and may capture appearance changes or camera motion rather than controllable behavior. In contrast, fully supervised approaches recover hand poses, object interactions, or retargeted trajectories to provide explicit motion supervision ( Kareer et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . Such supervision provides direct physical grounding, but relies on accurate pose estimation and human-to-robot correspondence. Human-video learning therefore yields a trade-off between stronger action grounding from explicit supervision and broader behavioral coverage from unlabeled videos.
blocks.zh: 现有方法试图从人类视频中从两个主要方向提取可采取行动的监督。 后期行动模型(Ye等人,2025年;Bu等人,2025年;Dai等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年a)推断出对子或对子序列的过渡变量,并将其用于代表或政策学习. 虽然自然可以被缩放到没有标记的动作视频中,但这些推断的变量约束不足,可能捕捉到外观变化或相机运动,而不是可控制的行为. 与此相对照的是,完全监督的方法可以恢复手,物体相互作用,或重新瞄准轨道,以提供明确的运动监督(Kareer等人,2025年;郑等人,2026年;刘等人,2026年c). 这种监督提供直接的物理地面,但依赖于准确的姿势估计和人对机器人的通信. 因此,人类-影视学习在以明确监督为基础的更有力行动与无标签视频更广泛的行为覆盖之间产生权衡。

blocks.en: Future observations provide a natural supervisory signal to bridge this gap as every video records the consequences that follow a behavior, regardless of embodiment. Predictive world models ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) and foresight-based VLAs ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) exploit this signal by forecasting future pixels, visual features, or trajectories, providing a direct account of what changes in the world. However, inferring the intermediate dynamics that result in these changes remains challenging, particularly from large-scale human videos without action annotations. Recent reasoning-augmented VLAs offer a useful perspective by introducing intermediate tokens, such as textual plans ( Zawalski et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , visual guidance ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) , continuous latents ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , or coarse action trajectories ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) , to structure action generation. This raises a natural question of whether such intermediate representations can instead be grounded in the dynamics they induce in the world, providing a shared action interface across embodiments.
blocks.zh: 未来的观察为弥补这一差距提供了自然的监督信号,因为每一段录像都记录了某一行为的后果,而不管其表现如何。 预测世界模型(Agarwal等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2024年;Assran等人,2025年)和基于展望的VLA(Zhang等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年a;Cai等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年c)通过预测未来的像素,视觉特征,或轨迹来利用这一信号,直接描述了世界的变化. 然而,推断导致这些变化的中间动态仍然具有挑战性,尤其是从没有行动说明的大规模人类视频中。 最近通过推理而获得承认的VLA提供了有用的视角,引入了中间符号,如文字计划(Zawalski等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年b),视觉指导. (Lee等人,2025年;Fang等人,2026年),连续潜伏物 (Huang等人,2026a),或粗动作轨迹( Zh等人,2026年),结构动作生成. 这自然提出了一个问题,即这种中间表述是否可以基于它们在世界中诱发的动态,提供一种跨越各种表现的共同行动界面。

blocks.en: Motivated by this perspective, we introduce ThinkWorld , a VLA learning framework that formulates action thoughts as Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) and reinforces them through world imagination. CoD represents an action as a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures how the world evolves over time, providing a common reasoning interface across human and robot behaviors. We first initialize this space with action-labeled demonstrations, grounding CoD in physically meaningful behavior. ThinkWorld then predicts the future world representation induced by each CoD and compares it with the future observation, using their alignment to reinforce action reasoning. As a result, videos even without motion annotations provide a learning signal, allowing large-scale human videos and robot trajectories to jointly refine the same CoD space. This training objective propagates through the shared VLM, enriching the representations for action prediction with knowledge of how motion transforms the world. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, we demonstrate that ThinkWorld enables human-to-robot skill composition and generalization to unseen scenarios.
blocks.zh: 基于这个观点,我们引入了思潮世界(ThinkWorld),这是一个VLA学习框架,它将行动思维作为动因链(CoD),并通过世界想象来强化它们. CoD代表作为离散运动符号序列的动作,它捕捉世界随时间演变的方式,提供了跨越人类和机器人行为的共同推理界面. 我们首先以行动标记的演示来初始化这个空间, 使CoD在物理上有意义的行为中落地. ThinkWorld随后预测了每个CoD所引领的未来世界代表,并将其与未来的观察相比较,利用它们的配合来强化行动推理. 因此,即使没有运动说明的视频也提供了学习信号,使得大规模人类视频和机器人轨迹可以共同完善相同的CoD空间. 这一培训目标通过共同的自愿活动清单进行宣传,丰富了行动预测的表述,并了解运动如何改变世界。 通过模拟基准和实际机器人评价,我们表明, " 思考世界 " 能够使人对机器人的技能组成和概括到看不见的情景。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce ThinkWorld , a VLA learning framework that couples a common VLM-native action-reasoning interface for both human and robot with internal world imagination. • We propose consequence-grounded reinforcement learning, which rewards CoD according to its consistency with observed future consequences and thereby enables action reasoning to improve from videos without action labels. • We show that ThinkWorld benefits from scaling action-unlabeled human video and enables human-to-robot skill transfer, allowing robots to execute complete tasks demonstrated in human videos while receiving robot supervision only for the constituent atomic skills.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们引入了ThinkWorld,这是一个VLA学习框架,它与具有世界内部想象力的人类和机器人共同的VLM-内在行动-理性界面。 我们提议进行基于后果的强化学习,这种学习根据COD与观察到的未来后果的一致性给予奖励,从而使行动推理能够从没有行动标签的视频中改进。 我们显示,ThinkWorld的好处是将没有标签的动作人类视频缩放,并使得人对机器人的技巧转移,使机器人能够完成在人类视频中展示的完整任务,同时接受机器人监督,只用于组成原子技能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Generalist Robot Policies. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024a ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2025 ) build upon advances in vision-language models (VLMs) ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) to learn generalist manipulation policies that map visual observations and language instructions to executable actions..
Despite acquiring broad capabilities from large-scale robot demonstrations, end-to-end imitation remains bounded by the behaviors observed during training.
Recent embodied reasoning methods introduce intermediate reasoning between perception and control ( Zawalski et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) .
ThinkAct ( Huang et al., 2026b ) reinforces textual and visual plans with action-aligned rewards, MolmoAct ( Lee et al., 2025 ) reasons through spatial traces, Fast-ThinkAct ( Huang et al., 2026a ) compresses reasoning into latent thoughts, and ACoT-VLA ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) predicts coarse reference actions to guide policy generation.
However, these methods largely augment robot demonstrations with intermediate reasoning, without explicitly grounding the learned thoughts in the task-relevant changes they induce in the world.
Their generalization to novel scenes and skills therefore remains constrained by the behavioral coverage of the underlying robot data.

通用机器人政策. 展望-语言行动(VLA)模型(Kim等人,2024年;Bjorck等人,2025年;Black等人,2024年a;Intelligence等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Chen等人,2025年b;Team等人,2025年)借鉴视觉语言模型(VLMs)(Bai等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年a;Liu等人,2025年;Ye等人,2026年a)的进步,学习通用操纵政策,绘制可执行行动的视觉观测和语言说明.
尽管从大规模机器人演示中获得了广泛的能力,但端到端的仿真仍然以训练中观察到的行为为界.
最近体现的推理方法引入了认知与控制之间的中间推理(Zawalski等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026b;Lee等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026a;Fang等人,2026年;Zhong等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026a年).
Think Act(Huang et al., 2026b)以行动一致的奖励强化了文字和视觉计划,Molmo Act(Lee et al., 2025)通过空间痕迹的理由,Fast-Think Act(Huang et al., 2026a)将推理压缩成潜伏的思想,ACoT-VLA(Zhong et al., 2026)预测粗糙的参考行动来指导政策的产生.
然而,这些方法在很大程度上用中间推理来增强机器人演示,而没有明确地将所学到的想法建立在它们在世界引发的任务相关变化的基础之上。
因此,它们被概括为新奇的场景和技能,仍然受到基本机器人数据的行为覆盖的限制。

blocks.en:
Learning Robot Policies from Human Videos. Improving generalization also requires expanding the behavioral coverage of the training data.
Human videos capture substantially greater diversity in scenes, objects, and skills than robot demonstrations, motivating their use for scaling robot learning ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
Supervised methods convert human interactions into robot-compatible representations, as in EgoScale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and EgoWAM ( Li et al., 2026a ) , but require costly cross-embodiment supervision.
Latent action models instead infer action-like variables from visual transitions without explicit control labels ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Routray et al., 2026 ) , with LAPA ( Ye et al., 2025 ) learning discrete latent actions before grounding them into robot control.
Such representations may capture appearance or embodiment cues rather than task-relevant dynamics. ThinkWorld grounds shared motion tokens and refines them by matching predicted and observed futures in videos.

blocks.en: World Models and Visual Foresight for Embodied Control. Recent advances in generative video models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) have enabled their application to a wide range of tasks ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Tosi et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . World models learn action-conditioned dynamics to support planning and policy optimization. Dreamer-style agents optimize policies through imagined rollouts ( Hafner et al., 2023 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) , while recent large-scale models acquire broad physical priors from diverse video data ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . In robotics, visual-foresight methods generate video plans or image subgoals to guide control ( Du et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2024b ; Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , while predictive VLAs forecast future pixels or latent features for planning and representation learning ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Kim et al., 2026b ) . More recent world-action models jointly model future-world evolution and robot actions ( Ye et al., 2026b ; Pai et al., 2025 ; Cen et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026c ) . In contrast, ThinkWorld does not use future prediction as the control output or an imagined rollout for policy optimization. Instead, it treats agreement between predicted and observed futures as a training-time signal to reinforce action-grounded Chain-of-Dynamics within the VLM. This directly turns observed world changes, including those in action-unlabeled videos, into supervision for action reasoning, while future prediction is discarded at deployment.
blocks.zh: 健美控制世界模型和视觉前视. 遗传性视频模型(Wan等人,2025年;Agarwal等人,2025年)的近期进展使得这些模型能够应用于广泛的任务(徐等人,2023年;Tosi等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年;Kim等人,2025年)。 世界模式学习有行动条件的动态,以支持规划和政策优化。 Dreamer风格的代理商通过想象的推出来优化政策(Hafner等人,2023年;Hafner等人,2025年),而最近的大规模模型则从各种视频数据中获得广泛的物理前科(Agarwal等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b). 在机器人学中,视觉前瞻方法生成指导控制的视频计划或图像子目标(Du等人,2023年;Black等人,2024年b;Bharadhwaj等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年),而预测VLA预测未来像素或潜在特征用于规划和表现学习(Zhang等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年a; Cai等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年c;Kim等人,2026年b). 较近期的世界行动模型联合模拟未来世界进化和机器人行动(Ye等人,2026b;Pai等人,2025年;Cen等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026c). 相比之下,ThinkWorld并没有将未来的预测作为控制输出或想象的推出来进行政策优化. 相反,它将预测未来与观测未来之间的一致视为一个培训时间信号,以加强以行动为基础的VLM内部的动态链。 这直接将所观察到的世界变化,包括未贴标签的视频中的变化,转变为对行动推理的监督,而未来的预测则在部署时被放弃。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : ThinkWorld architecture and training stages. In stage (a), supervised fine-tuning (SFT) tokenizes robot actions and annotated human hand motions into a unified discrete motion space to ground Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) reasoning, while CoD-conditioned imagination predicts the future visual feature. In stage (b), reinforcement learning (RL) uses the alignment between imagined and observed futures as a scalable reward for CoD reasoning over human and robot videos, strengthening action reasoning without motion annotations and improving guidance for continuous control.
blocks.zh: 图2:思想世界建筑和培训阶段。 在(a)阶段,受监督的微调(SFT)将机器人动作和注释的人类手动化为统一的离散运动空间,进行地面链动(CoD)推理,而CoD有条件的想象则预测未来的视觉特征. 在阶段(b)中,强化学习(RL)将想象未来和观察未来之间的对接作为可伸缩的奖励,奖励CoD推理优于人和机器人视频,加强动作推理而无需动作说明,改进对连续控制的指导.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: Given a language instruction l l , a current visual observation o t o_{t} , sampled history frames 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} , and proprioceptive state s t s_{t} in case of robot, our goal is to predict a continuous robot action sequence 𝐚 t \mathbf{a}_{t} . Rather than treating actions solely as supervision for continuous control, ThinkWorld turns them into a reasoning interface for modeling how an action should unfold and transform the world. Through supervised fine-tuning, we instantiate this interface as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t} , grounding its discrete motion vocabulary with action-labeled demonstrations across human and robot embodiments while learning CoD-conditioned future imagination through learnable queries that predict the future visual state (Sec. 3.2 ). We then reinforce CoD reasoning through world imagination, using the alignment between the imagined future and the observed future o t + Δ o_{t+\Delta} after a physical horizon Δ \Delta as a learning signal that does not require motion annotations (Sec. 3.3 ). Together, action grounding and reinforcement through world imagination refine the model representations used for continuous control while extending learning to action-unlabeled videos at scale.

blocks.en: 3.2 Chain-of-Dynamics for Embodied Action Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 健全行动动因链

blocks.en: Robot actions are typically represented in embodiment-specific control spaces, such as joint positions or end-effector poses. Although directly executable, these control targets keep action supervision tied to individual embodiments, limiting transfer across robots and from human demonstrations. We therefore introduce Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) , a sequence of discrete motion tokens that provides a shared action language for human and robot motion, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (a).
blocks.zh: 机器人动作一般表现在特异性控制空间中,如联合姿势或终端效应器的姿势. 尽管这些控制目标可以直接执行,但这些控制目标仍然将动作监督与个人的化身挂钩,限制了机器人之间和人类示威的转移. 因此,我们引入了链动符号(CoD),一个离散运动符号序列,为人类和机器人运动提供了共享的动作语言,如图2(a)所示.

blocks.en: Action-Grounded Reasoning Space. Let 𝐦 t \mathbf{m}_{t} denote a motion segment from a robot trajectory or an annotated human hand trajectory. We map both to a normalized delta end-effector representation and tokenize them with a FAST-style motion tokenizer 𝒯 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{T}(\cdot) ( Pertsch et al., 2025 ) , obtaining the target CoD sequence 𝐜 t ⋆ = 𝒯 ⁡ ( 𝐦 t ) \mathbf{c}_{t}^{\star}=\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{m}_{t}) in a shared discrete vocabulary. Conditioned on the instruction, visual history, and current observation, the VLM learns to generate 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t} autoregressively. This tokenization provides a common interface grounded in motion from both sources without assuming kinematic equivalence between humans and robots.

blocks.en: 3.3 Scaling Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning via Reinforcing World Imagination
blocks.zh: 3.3 通过增强世界想象力实现理性

blocks.en: Once trained with joint supervision, the model generates CoDs and predicts future visual states conditioned on them. However, prediction under teacher-forced CoDs alone does not train the VLM to plan the intermediate dynamics needed to reach a desired future state. Therefore, we reward sampled CoDs according to the agreement between their imagined and observed futures, encouraging the VLM to reason about the world changes implied by its CoDs, as shown in Fig. 2 (b). Since this reward requires only observed transitions, it enables the VLM to explore alternative CoDs and learn from human and robot videos without requiring action labels or executing candidate motions.
blocks.zh: 该模型经过联合监督培训后,生成CoD,并预测未来视线状态以它们为条件. 然而,仅靠教师推动的CODs的预测并不能训练VLM来规划达到预期未来状态所需的中间动态. 因此,我们根据它们想象的和观察到的未来之间的协议来奖励抽样的CoDs,鼓励VLM对其CoDs暗示的世界变化进行推理,如图2(b)所示. 由于这种奖励只需要观察到的过渡,使得VLM能够探索替代CoD,从人和机器人视频中学习,而不需要动作标签或执行候选动议.

blocks.en: Reward Shaping from World Imagination. For each candidate CoD, ThinkWorld predicts its future visual representation and compares it with the observed future in latent space. We compute the reward using a motion-enhanced feature similarity score sim ⁡ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) \operatorname{sim}(\cdot,\cdot) , which places greater weight on DINO feature agreement in patches with larger current-to-future changes: r world = sim ⁡ ( 𝐳 t + Δ , 𝐳 t + Δ ⋆ ) . r_{\mathrm{world}}=\operatorname{sim}(\mathbf{z}_{t+\Delta},\mathbf{z}_{t+\Delta}^{\star}). (3) The score retains a uniform contribution from the full scene to preserve global consistency while preventing redundant background regions from dominating the reward ( Shah et al., 2026 ) . Motion weighting uses only observed frames, so scoring requires no action annotations.

(3)分数保留了全场的统一贡献,以保持全球一致性,同时防止冗余背景区域主导奖励(Shah等人,2026年). 运动权重只使用被观测到的帧,因此评分不需要动作说明.

blocks.en: Optimizing CoD Reasoning with World-Imagination RL. We aim to learn CoDs that capture the intermediate dynamics leading from the current scene to a desired future state. To train this reasoning process, ThinkWorld samples alternative CoDs from the same visual context and rewards those whose imagined futures best match the observed future. These rewards let ThinkWorld explore alternative CoDs that could lead from the current scene to the observed future, allowing passive human and robot videos to guide action reasoning without action labels or online execution of candidate motions.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
Training Setup. For the motion tokenizer 𝒯 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{T}(\cdot) , we convert both robot actions and human wrist poses into a unified delta end-effector representation. We use Qwen3-VL-2B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as the VLM backbone with the action expert from MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Future queries are decoded by a Transformer decoder, with ground-truth future representations extracted using DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) .
Our training proceeds in two stages. During SFT and RL pre-training , we first fully fine-tune the VLM for CoD reasoning and future prediction, and then adapt the action expert while freezing the VLM following Driess et al. (2026) . We subsequently perform RL with K = 4 K=4 sampled trajectories, updating only the VLM while keeping the action expert frozen. We use 128 and 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for SFT and RL, respectively.
During Embodiment-Specific Post-Training , we further adapt the pretrained model to each target embodiment. ThinkWorld-LIBERO is trained on the standard LIBERO training set to evaluate generalization and robustness to novel environments and perturbations, while ThinkWorld-YAM is adapted on MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM for real-robot experiments. We use 32 and 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for the two settings, respectively.

blocks.en: 4.2 Real-World Generalization under Distribution Shifts
blocks.zh: 4.2 分配变化下的现实世界概况

blocks.en: We evaluate real-world generalization under matched in-domain (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings across three manipulation tasks: placing cups on a hanger, color matching, and object sorting. OOD settings introduce changes in object color or category and, in some cases, require trajectories not observed during task-specific training. For each task, we collect demonstrations across at least six object configurations and evaluate multiple settings under both ID and OOD conditions, with five trials per setting. These tasks require the policy to identify task-relevant object attributes, such as color and category, and adapt its motion accordingly.
blocks.zh: 我们在匹配的域内(ID)和分配外(OOD)设置下评价现实世界的概括,涉及三个操纵任务:将杯子放在挂架上,颜色匹配,以及对象排序. OOD设置引入对象颜色或类别的变化,在某些情况下需要在特定任务训练中未观察到的轨迹. 对于每项任务,我们收集至少6个对象配置的演示,并在ID和OOD条件下评价多个设置,每个设置有5个试验. 这些任务需要政策确定与任务相关的对象属性,如颜色和类别,并相应调整其运动.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , we compare ThinkWorld-YAM with Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) , MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , a VLA with explicit action reasoning, and LaWAM ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , which conditions action generation on predicted latent visual subgoals. While the methods perform similarly in-domain, their differences become more pronounced under OOD shifts. ThinkWorld maintains higher success rates when object appearances change or unseen trajectories are required, outperforming both MolmoAct2 and LaWAM. This suggests that grounding CoD reasoning in action-induced world changes helps the policy adapt to task-relevant changes rather than relying on appearance cues or memorized trajectories.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,我们比较了 " ThinkWorld-YAM " 与 " 传播政策 " (Chi等人,2023年),MolmoAct2(Fang等人,2026年),一个具有明确行动推理的VLA,以及LaWAM(Chen等人,2026年b),它们把产生行动作为预期潜在视觉次级目标的条件。 虽然这些方法在域内运作类似,但在OD变化中其差异变得更加明显。 ThinkWorld在需要对象外观变化或隐形轨迹时保持较高的成功率,表现优于MolmoAct2和LaWAM. 这表明,将COD推理基于行动引起的世界变化有助于政策适应与任务相关的变化,而不是依赖外观提示或记忆的轨迹。

blocks.en: 4.3 Acquiring Skill Composition from Human Experience
blocks.zh: 4.3 从人类经验中获取技能构成

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether human demonstrations can transfer compositional knowledge to robot control. We construct an oven manipulation task from reusable atomic robot skills and provide robot demonstrations only for the individual skills 1) open, 2) close, 3) put the left object in the oven , and 4) put the right object in the oven , while a human video demonstrates how a complete compositional task can be achieved. Existing end-to-end VLA approaches typically learn executable control from robot action supervision ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , making it difficult to compose complete robot tasks from human demonstrations when only atomic robot skills are supervised. Successful execution requires the robot to identify the relevant skills, preserve their temporal order, and transition between them without observing the complete robot trajectory during training. As shown in Fig. 4 , a human demonstration of open → \rightarrow put-left → \rightarrow close enables ThinkWorld to compose the corresponding robot skills and execute the full sequence in a single rollout. These results demonstrate that the shared CoD reasoning space enables compositional knowledge to transfer from human demonstrations to robot execution, allowing the robot to perform a complete skill sequence never demonstrated in robot data. Additional qualitative examples of skill composition in drawer manipulation are provided in the Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: 4.4 Robustness to Task and Environment Shifts in Simulation
blocks.zh: 4.4 模拟中任务强度和环境变化

blocks.en: We evaluate ThinkWorld on standard LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and the more challenging LIBERO-PRO ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . LIBERO evaluates manipulation across spatial, object, goal, and long-horizon task suites, while LIBERO-PRO introduces controlled shifts in object attributes, positions, instruction semantics, task goals, and environments. ThinkWorld-LIBERO is post-trained only on the standard LIBERO training set and evaluated directly on LIBERO-PRO without exposure to these perturbations. As shown in Tab. 1 , ThinkWorld achieves the best overall performance on both benchmarks, with average success rates of 97.3% on LIBERO and 55.6% on LIBERO-PRO. Notably, under task and environment shifts, ThinkWorld reaches 31.9% and 60.9%, outperforming VLA-JEPA by 11.1 and 19.9 percentage points, respectively. While VLA-JEPA also incorporates latent world modeling, these gains suggest that grounding CoD reasoning in action-induced world changes provides more transferable structure for adapting to shifts beyond the training distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们用标准LIBERO(刘等人,2023年)和更具挑战性的LIBERO-PRO(周等人,2025年)来评价思潮世界. LIBERO评价跨空间,对象,目标,以及长视任务套件的操纵,而LIBERO-PRO则引入了受控对象属性,位置,指令语义,任务目标,和环境的转变. Think World-LIBERO只接受LIBERO标准训练集的后期训练,并在LIBERO-PRO上直接评价,而不受这些干扰. 如塔布所示. 1,ThinkWorld在两个基准上都取得了最佳的整体表现,LIBERO的平均成功率为97.3%,LIBERO-PRO为55.6%. 值得注意的是,在任务和环境变化方面, " ThinkWorld " 达到31.9%和60.9%,分别比VLA-JEPA高11.1%和19.9%。 虽然VLA-JEPA还纳入了潜在的世界模式,但这些成果表明,将COD推理作为行动引起的世界变化的基础,为适应培训分配之外的转变提供了更多的可转移结构。

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 分析

blocks.en: Cross-Embodiment Structure of CoD. We first examine whether CoD induces a shared motion-centric structure across human and robot embodiments. For each sample, we extract the VLM hidden state of the final </think> token, which summarizes the generated CoD, and visualize these features with t-SNE in Fig. 6 . We use bimanual human and robot datasets, with colors denoting four 2D end-effector motion directions and marker shapes indicating dataset sources. Despite substantial differences in embodiment and visual appearance, samples with similar motion directions form coherent clusters that contain examples from multiple datasets, while samples from the same dataset separate according to their motions. This suggests that CoD features are organized primarily around action-relevant motion rather than embodiment identity, revealing a shared action-level structure shared across human and robot behaviors.
blocks.zh: COD的交叉蛋白质结构. 我们首先研究CoD是否在人和机器人的身上 诱导一个共同的运动中心结构 对于每个样本,我们提取最终的 </think > 令牌的VLM隐藏状态,它总结了生成的CoD,并以T-SNE在Fig中可视化这些特性. 6 (中文(简体) ). 我们使用双人和机器人数据集,颜色表示四个2D端效应运动方向,标记形状表示数据集来源. 尽管在表现和视觉外观上存在很大差异,但具有类似运动方向的样本组成了连贯的集群,包含来自多个数据集的实例,而来自同一数据集的样本则根据它们的运动而分开. 这表明CoD的特征主要围绕与动作相关的运动来组织,而不是表现身份,揭示出人类和机器人行为共同共享的动作层次结构.

blocks.en: Effectiveness of Human Data. We investigate the contribution of human egocentric video through a controlled pretraining study, keeping the amount of robot data fixed while increasing the human video fraction to 10%, 25%, and 50% of the total training data. We compare these variants against a robot-only baseline and an additional robot-only control that matches the training scale and number of training iterations of the 50% human-data variant by using additional robot data. This control helps distinguish the benefits of human video from those of increased training scale alone. These experimental configurations are designed to assess the contribution of heterogeneous human video to robustness and differ from our final model configuration. After SFT, each variant undergoes embodiment-specific post-training on LIBERO and is evaluated on LIBERO-PRO to assess generalization. As shown in Fig. 6 , overall success increases monotonically with the proportion of human video, from 45.4% for the robot-only baseline to 47.8% for the 50% human-data variant. The latter also outperforms the matched robot-only control by approximately 1.2 percentage points. These results suggest that the diversity provided by human egocentric video improves generalization beyond the gains attributable to increased training scale alone.
blocks.zh: 人类数据的有效性。 我们通过受控的预训研究来调查人类自我中心视频的贡献, 将机器人数据的数量固定下来, 同时将人类视频分数提高到 培训数据的10%、 25%和50%。 我们将这些变体与机器人唯一基线和附加的机器人唯一控制进行对比,通过使用额外的机器人数据来匹配50%的人文数据变体的训练规模和培训迭代次数. 这种控制有助于区分人录影带的优点和仅培训规模扩大的优点。 这些实验性配置旨在评估不同人类视频对稳健性的贡献,并与我们最终的模型配置不同. 在SFT之后,每个变体都接受关于LIBERO的特异性后培训,并在LIBERO-PRO上进行评估,以评估通用性. 如图6所示,整体成功率随着人类视频比例的提高而单调上升,从仅机器人基线的45.4%上升到50%的人数据变体的47.8%. 后者也比配对的机器人独占控制高出约1.2个百分点. 这些结果表明,以人为中心的视频所提供的多样性,不仅提高了培训规模,而且提高了普遍化程度。

blocks.en: Role of CoD in Future Prediction. We further examine how CoD contributes to future prediction. As shown in Fig. 7 , predictions conditioned on the generated CoD better capture the action-induced transition toward the ground-truth future, whereas shuffled, empty, or no-CoD variants tend to preserve the current-state structure or predict incorrect transitions. Tab. 3 quantitatively supports this observation: CoD achieves a cosine similarity of 0.74 across all patches, compared with 0.71–0.72 for the other conditions. The difference is more pronounced in the top 25% most dynamic target patches, where CoD reaches 0.62 compared with 0.54–0.55, indicating that CoD is particularly effective at predicting action-induced changes.
blocks.zh: COD在未来预测中的作用. 我们进一步审查二氧化碳如何对未来预测作出贡献。 如图7所示,以生成的CoD为条件的预测更好地抓住了行动引发的向地面真实未来的过渡,而洗涤、空置或无CoD变体则倾向于保留当前状态结构或预测不正确的过渡。 标签3在数量上支持这一看法: CoD在所有补丁上实现0.74的同位素相似性,而其他条件则达到0.71–0.72. 这一差异在前25%最动态的目标补丁中更为明显,与0.54–0.55相比,CoD达到0.62,这表明CoD在预测行动引起的变化方面特别有效.

blocks.en: We further examine what information CoD captures through attention visualization in Fig. 8 . Across both human and robot examples, CoD consistently attends to action-relevant dynamic regions, including human hands or robot arms and the manipulated objects, rather than static background regions. This pattern indicates that CoD focuses on the parts of the scene most involved in the ongoing motion and links these motion cues to the resulting changes in object state and configuration. Together with the future-prediction results, these visualizations suggest that CoD captures action-centric dynamics that ground future prediction in the state transitions induced by an action.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查通过在Fig的注意力可视化获取哪些信息。 8. 在整个人类和机器人方面,CoD始终关注与行动有关的动态区域,包括人类的手或机器人臂和被操纵的物体,而不是静态背景区域。 这种图案表明CoD主要关注当前运动中最涉及的场景部分,并将这些运动提示与由此产生的物体状态和配置变化联系起来. 这些可视化与未来预测结果一起,表明CoD捕捉到以行动为中心的动态,这些动态在某个动作诱导的状态过渡中支持未来的预测.

blocks.en: Effect of Training Components. To assess the effectiveness of each training component, we start from a baseline consisting of the Qwen3-VL backbone with the MolmoAct2 action expert, and progressively add visual history, future prediction, CoD, and world-imagination RL. As shown in Tab. 3 , history provides temporal context and slightly improves the average success rate from 40.1% to 40.7%. Future prediction brings a much larger gain to 50.4%, indicating the benefit of explicitly modeling how the scene evolves. Adding CoD further raises performance to 54.4%, with consistent improvements across all distribution shifts, showing the value of grounding future prediction in action-relevant dynamics. Finally, world-imagination RL improves the average to 55.6%, with further gains under position, task, and environment shifts, demonstrating its role in refining CoD reasoning beyond supervised training. Overall, these ablations support the design of ThinkWorld, showing that each component contributes to more robust and generalizable action reasoning.
blocks.zh: 培训部分的效果。 为了评估每个培训部分的有效性,我们从一个基线开始,由与MolmoAct2行动专家的Qune3-VL主干线组成,并逐步增加视觉历史、未来预测、CoD和世界想象RL。 如塔布所示. 3,历史提供了时间背景,并略微提高了平均成功率,从40.1%提高到40.7%。 未来预测带来50.4%的更大收益,表明明确模拟场景演进的好处. 添加CoD进一步将性能提高到54.4%,在所有分配变化中持续改善,显示未来预测与行动有关的动态的价值。 最后,世界想象的RL使平均增长到55.6%,在位置、任务和环境变化方面有了进一步的收益,这证明了它在完善COD推理方面的作用,超出了监督培训的范围。 总的来说,这些浮雕支持了ThinkWorld的设计,表明每个组件都有助于更有力和概括的行动推理.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present ThinkWorld , a VLA learning framework that learns transferable Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) through reinforcement learning with world imagination. By grounding action thoughts in the world changes they induce, ThinkWorld learns a common representation across human and robot embodiments and extends action reasoning to videos without explicit action annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments, validating the effectiveness of learning transferable action reasoning from observed world dynamics and its potential for scaling robot learning with diverse human and robot experience.
blocks.zh: 我们提出思考世界(ThinkWorld),这是一个VLA学习框架,通过用世界想象力的强化学习来学习可转移的动态链。 ThinkWorld通过将行动思想定位到它们诱导的世界变化中,在人和机器人的化身中学习了共同的表述,并将行动推理扩展到没有明确行动说明的视频. 广泛的实验展示了有效的人对机器人的转移和对不可见任务和环境的强烈概括,验证了从观测到的世界动态中学习可转移动作推理的有效性及其利用不同的人类和机器人经验来推广机器人学习的潜力.

blocks.en: ThinkWorld uses Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as its vision-language backbone and a frozen DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ target encoder ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . The DINO encoder receives the main-camera target image at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution and produces a 14 × 14 14\times 14 grid of 1,280-dimensional patch features. We append 64 learned future-query tokens to the VLM sequence. A two-layer MLP and a six-layer cross-attention decoder map their 2,048-dimensional hidden states to 196 predicted DINO patch features. The future target is the main-camera observation closest to exactly one second after the current observation; samples more than 50 ms from the requested time are masked from the future loss.
blocks.zh: ThinkWorld使用Qune3-VL-2B-Instruct(Bai等人,2025年)作为其视觉语言骨干和冷冻的DINOv3 VIT-H/16+目标编码器(Siméoni等人,2025年). DINO编码器以224×224\times 224分辨率接收主摄像头目标图像,并生成14×1414\times 14网格的1,280维补丁特性. 我们在VLM序列中附加了64个学习到的未来清静符号. 一个两层的 MLP 和一个六层的交叉刻度解码器图 他们的2,048维隐藏状态 196 预言的 DINO 补丁特性. 未来的目标是在当前观测之后最接近精确一秒的主摄像头观测;从要求的时间提取的50多米样本被掩盖为未来损失.

blocks.en: Continuous actions are produced by an action expert initialized from MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . The expert contains 36 non-causal Transformer blocks with hidden width 768 and operates in FP32. It exposes a maximum 30 × 32 30\times 32 action tensor, but a two-dimensional validity mask restricts each example to its dataset-native horizon and action channels. The expert receives layer-wise Qwen key/value features from input tokens only; generated CoD tokens and future-query tokens are not part of its direct context.
blocks.zh: 从Molmo Act2(Fang等人,2026年)初始化的一位行动专家不断行动。 专家包含36个非因果变形器区块,隐藏宽度768,运行于FP32. 它暴露出一个最大30×32 30\时的32个动作计数器,但是一个二维有效性罩将每个实例限制在它的数据集-内在视野和行动通道上. 专家仅从输入符中接收层次的Qwen密钥/值特性;生成的CoD密钥和未来query密钥不属于其直接上下文.

blocks.en: Following MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , we encode proprioceptive state as discrete tokens. Each dataset-native state dimension is normalized using training-split statistics, clipped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , uniformly quantized into 256 bins, and serialized between dedicated state-boundary tokens. The native state width is preserved, so no common padded state vector is exposed in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 继MolmoAct2(Fang et al., 2026年)之后,我们把自制状态编码为离散符号. 每个数据集-内在状态的维度都通过培训-分解统计实现正常化,剪切为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1],统一量化为256个桶,并在专用的国家边界符号之间进行序列化. 原生状态宽度被保留下来,因此没有常见的加法状态向量在提示中暴露出来.

blocks.en: Dataset-side resizing is disabled. Qwen retains the source aspect ratio, with a pixel-area range of 4,096–200,704 for each current image and 4,096–50,176 for each history frame. State conditioning is dropped with probability 0.10 and wrist views with probability 0.20 during supervised training. The maximum multimodal sequence length is 2,048 tokens; over-length examples are removed rather than silently truncating their supervision.

blocks.en: CoD tokens receive language cross-entropy supervision, whereas future-query tokens are excluded from cross-entropy and supervise only the future projector. Action SFT uses an empty <think>...</think> wrapper and disables assistant-token cross-entropy.
blocks.zh: CoD令牌接受语言交叉内涵监督,而未来清爽令牌则被排除在交叉内涵之外,只监督未来的投影仪. Action SFT 使用空的 < think>... </think> 包装并禁用助理托肯交叉连接。

blocks.en: We train a motion tokenizer following the FAST architecture ( Pertsch et al., 2025 ) on one-second windows of consecutive wrist-motion deltas from robot and human trajectories. Each time step contains a 6D motion vector for one hand or a 12D vector for two hands: translation in meters and rotation as a rotation vector in radians, with gripper state excluded. We normalize translation and rotation using fixed scales of 0.3448 m and 0.9119 rad, respectively, and encode the sequences with a vocabulary of 2,048 tokens. Robot poses are expressed in the robot base frame, whereas human poses are expressed in an actor-centered frame whose + z +z axis is gravity-aligned and whose + x +x axis follows the actor’s current yaw. Training on both domains yields a shared token space for intended wrist motion. The tokens are not executed as native robot actions; a separate continuous action expert predicts executable actions.
blocks.zh: 我们按照FAST架构(Pertsch等人,2025年),在机器人和人类轨迹连续腕动三角洲的一秒钟窗口上,训练一个运动指示器. 每个时间步骤都包含一只手的6D运动向量或两只手的12D向量:以米翻译,以弧度旋转为旋转向量,不包含抓力状态. 我们分别使用0.3448米和0.9119弧度的固定比例尺实现翻译和旋转的正常化,并将序列编码为2 048个令牌的词汇。 机器人的姿势在机器人基框中表示,而人类的姿势则在以演员为中心的框架中表示,其+ z + z 轴是重力对齐的,其+ x + x 轴跟随演员当前的yaw. 两个领域的培训为预定的腕动提供了共同的象征性空间。 符号不是作为原生机器人动作执行的;单独的连续动作专家预测可执行动作.

blocks.en: VLM SFT combines robot trajectories from BimanualYAM ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , RoboCOIN ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , Bridge ( Walke et al., 2023 ) , RT-1 ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) , and BC-Z ( Jang et al., 2021 ) with egocentric human-motion trajectories from EgoVerse ( Punamiya et al., 2026 ) and EgoDex Hoque et al. (2026) . Table 4 summarizes the frozen source scale and native action contracts without exposing dataset sampling weights. Episode and frame counts describe source data before the episode-disjoint validation holdout, and a frame denotes one trajectory timestep rather than one image per camera. For Action SFT, we exclude the 50-Hz RoboCOIN trajectories and retain only its 30-Hz trajectories.

blocks.en: Auxiliary visual-language supervision covers image and video captioning, caption question answering, spatial reasoning, pointing, counting, point tracking, robotics-oriented pointing, and robot VQA. Specifically, Pixmo-Cap ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) , Molmo2-ER ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , Molmo2 Cap-LLaVA, Molmo2 Video-Track ( Clark et al., 2026 ) , RoboPoint ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and RoboVQA ( Sermanet et al., 2023 ) . These examples retain their language targets and do not contribute continuous-action or future-feature losses.
blocks.zh: 辅助视觉语言监督涵盖图像和视频字幕,字幕问答,空间推理,指点,计数,点跟踪,面向机器人的指点,以及机器人VQA. 具体而言,Pixmo-Cap(Deitke等人,2025年),Molmo2-ER(Fang等人,2026年),Molmo2 Cap-LLAVA,Molmo2视频跟踪(Clark等人,2026年),RoboPoint (Yuan等人,2025年),和RoboVQA(Sermanet等人,2023年). 这些例子保留了语言目标,不会造成连续行动或未来情况的损失。

blocks.en: B.1 Simulation Benchmarks and Baselines
blocks.zh: B.1 模拟基准和基线

blocks.en: We fine-tune our policy only on standard LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and use its unmodified tasks as the in-distribution reference. We then evaluate the trained policy on LIBERO-PRO and LIBERO-Plus without further adaptation to either benchmark. We select LIBERO-PRO as the primary benchmark because its controlled changes to objects, object positions, task specifications, and environments directly test whether the policy can adapt its behavior to new manipulation settings. LIBERO-Plus additionally covers camera, lighting, background, and sensor-noise perturbations, which probe perceptual robustness beyond our main methodological focus. We report a supplementary LIBERO-Plus evaluation in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们只根据标准的LIBERO(Liu等人,2023年)微调政策,将其未修改的任务作为分配参考. 然后,我们评价经过培训的关于LIBERO-PRO和LIBERO-Plus的政策,而不进一步调整这两个基准。 我们选择LIBERO-PRO作为主要基准,因为其控制下的对象,对象位置,任务规格以及环境的改变直接测试了政策是否能够使其行为适应新的操纵设置. LIBERO-Plus还覆盖了相机,照明,背景,和传感器噪声扰动,它探测了超出我们主要方法重点的感知强度. 我们报告附录C.4中的LIBERO-Plus补充评价。

blocks.en: B.2 Real-Robot Setup
blocks.zh: B.2 真机器人设置

blocks.en: We use the BimanualYAM robot system to collect our in-lab dataset and evaluate trained policies. As shown in Fig. 9 , the system comprises two YAM arms and three RealSense D405 cameras: one providing a top view and one mounted on each wrist. Policies use RGB observations only.
blocks.zh: 我们使用BimanualYAM机器人系统来收集我们的实验室数据集并评价训练有素的政策. 如图9所示,该系统由2个YAM臂和3个RealSense D405相机组成:一个提供顶部视图,一个安装在腕上。 政策只使用RGB观察.

blocks.en: Policy inference runs on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090. To account for differences in inference latency, we query each policy and execute its actions at the same 15 Hz control rate, while the remaining system components run at 30 Hz. For each predicted action chunk, we execute the first half and then replan using the latest observation.
blocks.zh: 政策推论运行在单一的NVIDIA RTX 3090上. 为了考虑推断延迟性的差异,我们查询每项政策,并以相同的15赫兹控制率执行行动,而其余的系统组件运行在30赫兹. 对每个预言的动作块,我们执行前半部分,然后利用最新的观察重新规划.

blocks.en: B.3 Real-Robot Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.3 实际机器人评价

blocks.en: Figure 9 : BimanualYAM setup.
blocks.zh: 图9:BimanualYAM设置.

blocks.en: For the real-robot experiments, we evaluate three tasks on the bimanual YAM platform: color matching (60 robot demonstrations), cup hanging (45), and object sorting (100). Within each task, the demonstrations span multiple trajectories and environment configurations, and we use them jointly to fine-tune a single task-specific policy. The tasks are designed to test whether the policy can infer task-level regularities and adapt its actions to the current scene rather than memorize a single trajectory. Separately, we study skill composition on the oven task using 100 robot episodes of atomic-action trajectories and 90 human-video episodes of full task sequences. We co-train a single model on the combined robot and human datasets. Example task trajectory for four tasks can be found in Fig. 10 (a) and Fig. 13 (a).
blocks.zh: 对于真机器人实验,我们评价双人YAM平台上的三项任务:色彩匹配(60个机器人演示),杯吊(45),以及对象排序(100). 在每项任务中,示范跨越多个轨道和环境布局,我们共同利用它们来微调一项针对具体任务的单一政策。 这些任务旨在测试政策是否能够推断任务层次的规律性,使其行动适应当前的场景,而不是记住单一的轨迹. 另外,我们利用原子动作轨迹的100个机器人事件和90个全任务序列的人-视频事件,研究烤箱任务的技能构成。 我们在机器人和人类的组合数据集上共同训练一个单一模型. 图10(a)和图13(a)列出了四项任务的示例任务轨迹。

blocks.en: We fine-tune ThinkWorld for 50,000 steps, applying LoRA to the VLM and fully updating the action DiT decoder. ThinkWorld can also leverage human videos during training; for these samples, we optimize only the VLM future-prediction loss and omit the action DiT loss. We train each baseline for 50,000 steps using its model-specific fine-tuning recipe from the official LeRobot ( Cadene et al., 2024 ) repository.
blocks.zh: 我们微调了"思考世界"5万步,将LORA应用到VLM中,并全面更新动作DiT解码器. ThinkWorld在训练期间也可以利用人类的视频;对于这些样本,我们只能优化VLM未来预测损失,省略动作DiT损失. 我们使用官方的LeRobot(Cadene等人,2024年)储存库提供的其模型特有的微调配方,对每个基线进行5万个步骤的培训。

blocks.zh: C.1 详细的实际机器人评价结果

blocks.en: In-domain and out-of-domain task evaluation. Tab. 6 reports detailed rollout success rates under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions for all tasks. ThinkWorld achieves the highest success rate in all six task–condition pairs, succeeding in all 60 ID trials and 52 of 60 OOD trials. Its macro and micro success rates are 94.4% and 93.3%, respectively, compared with 62.2% and 60.0% for the strongest baseline, MolmoAct2. Example in-domain and out-of-domain rollout trajectories for all compared methods are shown in Figs. 10 (b) and (c) respectively.
blocks.zh: 域外任务评价. 附表6详细列出了所有任务在分配(ID)和分配(OOD)条件下的成功率。 ThinkWorld在所有6个任务-条件配对中都取得了最高的成功率,在所有60个ID测试和60个OOD测试中的52个都取得了成功. 其宏观和微观成功率分别为94.4%和93.3%,而最强基线MolmoAct2为62.2%和60.0%。 图10(b)和(c)分别显示所有比较方法的域内和域外推出轨迹。

blocks.en: Skill composition. Fig. 13 presents qualitative results for real-robot skill composition in oven and drawer manipulation tasks. Each task involves opening the oven or a specified drawer, optionally placing the left or right object inside, and closing it. Robot demonstrations cover only the individual atomic skills (OPEN, PUT-L, PUT-R, and CLOSE; panel (a)), while human demonstrations specify complete skill sequences (panel (b)). The oven tasks include open → \rightarrow close and open → \rightarrow put-left → \rightarrow close . The drawer tasks include open → \rightarrow put-left → \rightarrow close and open → \rightarrow put-right → \rightarrow close for the upper drawer, and open → \rightarrow put-left → \rightarrow close for the lower drawer. The successful rollouts in panel (c) show ThinkWorld executing these compositions under the corresponding natural-language instructions, manipulating the specified objects and compartments while preserving the required skill order. These qualitative results illustrate the transfer of compositional knowledge from human demonstrations to robot execution without complete robot task trajectories during training.

blocks.en: Fig. 15 expands the PCA visualization of future-prediction representations across five CoD conditions: the original CoD, shuffled CoD, empty CoD, a donor CoD from another episode, and no CoD. This comparison illustrates how the predicted future representations vary with CoD conditioning.
blocks.zh: 图15扩展了PCA未来预测表现的可视化,跨越了5个CoD条件:原CoD,洗牌CoD,空空CoD,另一个插曲中的一个捐助者CoD,没有CoD. 这一比较表明,预测的未来表述如何与CoD条件不同。

blocks.en: Fig. 17 extends the CoD-to-input-observation attention maps shown in the main text and additionally shows attention from future-prediction tokens to the input observation. CoD attention tends to concentrate on dynamic, task-relevant regions, whereas future-prediction attention is distributed more broadly across the scene. This pattern suggests that CoD emphasizes localized changes relevant to action, while future prediction incorporates wider scene context.
blocks.zh: 图17将正文中显示的CoD-对输入-观测的注意图扩展,并额外显示从未来预测符号到输入观察的注意. COD的注意力往往集中在动态的,与任务相关的区域,而未来预测的注意力则更广泛地分布在全场. 这种模式表明CoD强调与行动相关的局部变化,而未来的预测则包含更广泛的场景背景.

blocks.en: C.3 Closed-Loop Future-Prediction Results
blocks.zh: C.3 闭环未来预测结果

blocks.en: Table 7 : Out-of-the-box performance on SimplerEnv.
blocks.zh: 表7:SimmerEnv上的外框性能.

blocks.en: Tab. 7 reports SimplerEnv ( Li et al., 2024 ) success rates without additional embodiment-specific fine-tuning for this benchmark. The model nevertheless encountered Bridge and RT-1 data during SFT and RL, providing prior experience with related robot settings. It achieves 49.31% on Google visual matching, 46.54% on the Google-VA variants (micro average), and 41.67% on WidowX visual matching, with an overall micro success rate of 46.51%. These results show that the policy can complete a substantial fraction of SimplerEnv rollouts without benchmark-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: Tab. 7报告了SimmerEnv(Li等人,2024年)的成功率,但没有对这一基准进行额外的具体体现的微调。 然而,该模型在SFT和RL期间遇到了Bridge和RT-1数据,提供了以往在相关机器人设置方面的经验. 它在Google视觉比对上实现了49.31%,在Google-VA变体上实现了46.54%(微平均值),在WiverX视觉比对上实现了41.67%,总体微观成功率为46.51%. 这些结果显示,该政策可以在不进行具体基准调整的情况下完成SimmerEnv推出的很大一部分。

blocks.en: Fig. 18 visualizes future predictions during closed-loop SimplerEnv rollouts. In each column, the one-second-ahead prediction is paired with the observation subsequently reached at the predicted time. The predictions are PCA-projected feature maps and their spatial structure and progression closely track the corresponding observations across the three examples. This qualitative alignment suggests that the future representation remains informative as the policy encounters its own observations and replans under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 图18可视化未来在闭路SimmerEnv推出时的预测. 在每列中,一秒前的预测与随后在预测时间达到的观测对齐. 预测是五氯苯甲醚预测的地物图及其空间结构和进展,密切跟踪这三个实例的相应观测结果。 这种质的调整表明,随着政策在分配转变中遇到自己的观察和重新规划,今后的代表性仍然是丰富的。

blocks.en: C.4 LIBERO-Plus Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: C.4 LIBERO-Plus 评价结果

blocks.en: Tab. 8 reports zero-shot LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2026 ) results using the policy fine-tuned only on standard LIBERO. ThinkWorld achieves the highest reported Avg. among the four methods at 71.7%, exceeding DreamVLA by 1.8 percentage points. It leads under robot initial-state, lighting, and object-layout perturbations. In particular, ThinkWorld reaches 70.5% on robot initial-state changes, compared with 40.8% for the next-best method, and 79.6% on object-layout changes, compared with 74.2%. These results are consistent with our goal of adapting actions to changed physical configurations and provide supplementary evidence of generalization beyond standard LIBERO.
blocks.zh: Tab. 8报告零镜头LIBERO-Plus(Fei等人,2026年)只使用标准LIBERO对政策进行微调的结果. ThinkWorld以71.7%的成绩在四种方法中达到最高的Avg,超过DreamVLA1.8个百分点. 它在机器人初始状态,照明和物体铺设扰动下领先. 特别是,ThinkWorld在机器人初始状态变化中达到70.5%,而次佳方法为40.8%,对象放出变化为79.6%,而74.2%. 这些结果符合我们的目标,即使行动适应改变的物理配置,并提供超出标准LIBERO的补充证据。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports steady-state batch-1 policy latency with CUDA graph capture disabled, using eager inference without static-shape graph setup. All models are measured on the same NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU, with five warm-up calls followed by 50 CUDA-synchronized timed calls. Each model uses its native deployed input contract, so the table reflects practical policy latency rather than an identical-input architecture ablation.
blocks.zh: 表9报告CUDA图的稳态批次-1政策缓期性,使用不设静态形状图的急切推论来捕获已失效。 所有模型都用相同的NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU进行测量,5个热量调用之后还有50个CUDA同步定时调用. 每个模型都使用其原产地部署的输入合同,因此该表反映了实际的政策耐久性,而不是一个相同的输入结构减缩.

blocks.en: ThinkWorld uses the reasoning process only during training, where it encourages the VLM to learn more action-centric representations. The deployed policy does not execute this process at inference, so each policy call avoids its additional runtime computation. This separation offers an explanation for how training-time reasoning can support strong task performance while preserving low inference latency.
blocks.zh: ThinkWorld只在训练时使用推理过程,鼓励VLM学习更多以行动为中心的表述. 所部署的政策并没有在推论中执行这个过程,因此每个政策调用都避免了额外的运行时间计算. 这种分离解释培训时间推理如何支持强有力的任务执行,同时保持低推论延迟。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和可复制性

blocks.en: Training results are obtained from a single training seed; accordingly, the reported episode-level confidence intervals characterize evaluation variability rather than variation across independently trained checkpoints. For real-robot experiments, we report the number of physical trials and task-level results to make the evaluation scope explicit. Inference latency should be interpreted under the stated deployment setup, as it varies with hardware and input configuration. To support reproducibility, we provide trial denominators, model initialization details, training configurations, and hardware specifications alongside the aggregate results.
blocks.zh: 培训结果来自单一的培训种子;因此,所报告的点级信任间隔是评价可变性的特点,而不是独立训练的检查站之间的差异。 对于真机器人实验,我们报告物理试验的次数和任务级结果,以明确评价范围. 推断延迟应该根据说明的部署设置来解释,因为它与硬件和输入配置不同。 为了支持可复制性,我们提供了试验分母、模型初始化细节、培训配置和硬件规格以及综合结果。

Figure 16 : Qualitative future-prediction results. Each row is one episode.
The first two columns show the current and ground-truth future RGB
observations, and the next two show PCA projections of the
ground-truth DINO features for those frames.
The remaining five columns show the predicted future DINO features
under different CoD conditions: with CoD, shuffled CoD, empty CoD,
a CoD taken from a different (donor) episode, and without CoD.
All PCA panels share one color mapping.

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Additional attention visualizations. Attention maps from CoD and future-prediction tokens to the input observation. CoD attention concentrates on dynamic, task-relevant regions, while future-prediction attention is more broadly distributed across the scene.
blocks.zh: 图17:更多关注可视化。 从CoD和未来预测符号到输入观察的注意地图. COD的注意力集中在动态的,与任务相关的区域,而未来预测的注意力则更广泛地分布在全场.

blocks.en: Figure 18 : One-second-ahead future predictions during closed-loop SimplerEnv rollouts. For each task, the upper row shows observations actually reached by the policy, while the lower row shows PCA-projected future representations predicted at the preceding replanning horizon. Each column pairs a prediction with the observation at its target time, so their scene structure should correspond. The close qualitative alignment in layout and task progress shows that the predictions track the states encountered during closed-loop execution. The initial frame has no preceding prediction.
blocks.zh: 图18:闭路式简易车中未来预测的一秒钟 信封启动。 对于每项任务,上行显示的是政策实际达到的观察,下行显示的是先前重新规划时预测的PCA预测的未来表现. 每列在目标时间将一个预测与观测对齐,因此它们的场景结构应该对应. 在布局和任务进度上紧密的质的配合表明,预测会跟踪在闭路执行过程中遇到的状态. 最初的框架没有事先的预测.
